finding: ITEM-48217 is an R3 refrigerated ready-to-eat TCS food governed by active AFP-48217-03.
The approved DTSL is 45 calendar days from pack date and the controlling ELD is the printed USE BY date.
The applicable MRL is 65% of DTSL, rounded up: ceil(45 × 0.65) = 30 calendar days.
Gate Arrival Time establishes the Northstar Receipt Date as 2026-09-10.
All 240 cases are lot GVK-260823-A with controlling ELD 2026-10-07.
Actual Remaining Life is 27 calendar days because receipt date is day 0 and 2026-10-07 minus 2026-09-10 equals 27 days.
The lot fails MRL by 3 days (27 actual versus 30 required) but is not expired because actual Remaining Life is positive.
No approved Freshness Exception is attached, and the vendor confirms none was requested before shipment.
Failed MRL is ordinarily a commercial freshness failure and does not by itself establish unsafe product or a recall.
The applicable product-temperature receiving maximum is 41°F.
The required three initial spatially separated product readings were taken: 38.9°F, 42.4°F, and 43.1°F; two were out of specification.
Any out-of-spec product reading triggers Temperature Hold and expanded sampling rather than averaging the readings.
Six expanded product readings were taken; four remain out of specification at 42.0°F, 42.7°F, 43.3°F, and 41.8°F.
All 240 cases remain segregated in refrigerated hold zone H-C2 and are not saleable.
The Temperature Hold has no release record and Q&R technical disposition is unresolved.
Eric Nolan's recall statement is an unverified human interpretation, not a declared recall or authoritative policy record.
The freshness and temperature concerns are independent observations affecting the same shipment.
